pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Historical Promo Discount Amounts Before Stating Past Prices
lesson.when: Asked to state a past discounted price or promo calculation, but available tools and sources only indicate that a promo code expired without detailing its historical discount value
lesson.do: Acknowledge the expired promo code using verified data and explain current pricing, without stating an unverified historical price or discount amount
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty regarding the exact past price or discount amount from the expired promotion
